en.label: A Worker stops in the middle of a Flow, and a new Worker finishes it

events.title: Flow started
events.text: You start the Flow. Dex Server records it.
Worker 1 runs Charge. Dex saves its result.
events.title: Charge · Execute

events.text: Ship waits on a 60-second Timer. Dex Server holds the wait.
events.title: Ship · WaitFor

events.text: Worker 1 stops.
events.title: Worker 1 stopped

events.text: The Timer keeps running on Dex Server. No Worker is needed.
events.title: Timer keeps running

events.text: Worker 2 starts and connects to Dex.
events.title: Worker 2 connected

events.text: The Timer fires.
events.title: Timer fired

events.text: Worker 2 runs Ship. Charge does not run again.
events.title: Ship · Execute

events.text: The Flow completes.
events.title: Flow closed

en.summary: Charge ran once. Ship ran once.

zh-Hans.label: Worker 在 Flow 中途停止，新的 Worker 把它跑完

events.title: Flow 启动
events.text: 你启动 Flow，Dex Server 记录下来。
Worker 1 运行 Charge。Dex 保存它的结果。
events.title: Charge · Execute

events.text: Ship 等一个 60 秒的 Timer。这个等待由 Dex Server 保管。
events.title: Ship · WaitFor

events.text: Worker 1 停止。
events.title: Worker 1 停止

events.text: Timer 在 Dex Server 上继续计时，不需要 Worker。
events.title: Timer 继续计时

events.text: Worker 2 启动并连接 Dex。
events.title: Worker 2 已连接

events.text: Timer 到时。
events.title: Timer 到时

events.text: Worker 2 运行 Ship。Charge 不会再运行。
events.title: Ship · Execute

events.text: Flow 完成。
events.title: Flow 关闭

zh-Hans.summary: Charge 只运行了一次，Ship 只运行了一次。

en.label: A Worker stops while a tool call waits for approval, and the session carries on after a restart

events.title: Message received
events.text: You send a message. Dex Server records it in the session Flow.
RunModel calls the model. The model asks to call cancel_order.
events.title: RunModel · Execute

events.text: cancel_order waits in AwaitToolApproval. Dex Server holds the wait.
events.title: AwaitToolApproval · WaitFor

events.text: You stop the program, and its Worker stops.
events.title: Worker stopped

events.text: The approval keeps waiting on Dex Server. No Worker is needed.
events.title: Approval keeps waiting

events.text: You start the program again. Its Worker connects to Dex.
events.title: Worker restarted

events.text: You approve cancel_order at the program's prompt. Dex Server records the answer.
events.title: cancel_order approved

events.text: cancel_order runs once. The model writes the reply.
events.title: CallTool · Execute

events.text: The turn completes.
events.title: Turn closed

en.summary: The model call before the stop stayed done, and cancel_order ran once.

zh-Hans.label: 工具调用等待审批时 Worker 停止，重启后会话继续

events.title: 收到消息
events.text: 你发送一条消息，Dex Server 把它记录到会话 Flow 中。
RunModel 调用模型。模型请求调用 cancel_order。
events.title: RunModel · Execute

events.text: cancel_order 在 AwaitToolApproval 中等待。这个等待由 Dex Server 保管。
events.title: AwaitToolApproval · WaitFor

events.text: Worker 停止。
events.title: Worker 停止

events.text: 审批继续在 Dex Server 上等待，不需要 Worker。
events.title: 审批继续等待

events.text: Worker 重新启动并连接 Dex。
events.title: Worker 重启

events.text: 你在程序的提示符处批准 cancel_order，Dex Server 记录这个答复。
events.title: cancel_order 已批准

events.text: cancel_order 只运行一次。模型写出回复。
events.title: CallTool · Execute

events.text: 这一轮完成。
events.title: 本轮关闭

zh-Hans.summary: 停止前的模型调用保持已完成，cancel_order 只运行了一次。
